description: The address of 787daily's day-by-day trip plan for a Puerto Rico town: places from 787daily's guide arranged by day, with the forecast and events for those dates when a start date is given. Gives the URL to open; it does not return the plan itself. Validated: town is one of the 78; days 1 to 5; interest one of surf, diving, beaches, food-and-nightlife, outdoors-and-culture (omit for the town's own best fit); start a future date (YYYY-MM-DD, Puerto Rico time, up to 18 months ahead). Cite 787daily.com/plan/.

interest.description: What the trip is for; omit for the town's best fit

town.description: The town to plan from, e.g. 'Rincón' or 'rincon'
